title: Baby Bonding Activities: Why Bathing & Water Play Build Attachment

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了用时间换金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的转型之路。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.zh: 请通过描述栏中链接的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。

sentences.en: Water is so much more than just a way to keep our children and ourselves clean.
sentences.zh: 水不仅仅是让我们孩子和我们自己保持清洁的方式。

sentences.en: It can be a powerful tool for bonding, calming the nervous system, and laying the foundations for trust and confidence.
sentences.zh: 它还可以成为建立亲密关系、平复神经系统以及为信任和自信奠定基础的强大工具。

sentences.en: Whether you're a parent looking to feel more confident with your newborn or a professional curious about how sensory experiences shape attachment, this conversation is for you.
sentences.zh: 无论你是想在面对新生儿时感到更自信的父母，还是对感官体验如何塑造依恋关系感到好奇的专业人士，这次对话都适合你。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a clinical psychologist, and today I'm joined by Jo from Aquasensory, where we'll be exploring how water from bath time to baby swimming can nurture connection
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne 博士，今天我邀请到了来自 Aquasensory 的 Jo，我们将共同探讨从洗澡时间到婴儿游泳，水是如何滋养连接

sentences.en: and resilience.
sentences.zh: 和韧性的。

sentences.en: Like and subscribe for more.
sentences.zh: 点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologist, and I am joined here today by Jo Wilson.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne 博士，今天和我一起的是 Jo Wilson。

sentences.en: Welcome along, Jo.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，Jo。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 哦，太感谢了。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: So before we dive into who you are and all of that stuff, why is water such a powerful medium, really, for helping bonding with babies?
sentences.zh: 那么，在我们深入了解你的背景之前，为什么水对于帮助婴儿建立亲密关系来说，真的是一种如此强大的媒介呢？

sentences.en: I think sometimes we underestimate the power of water, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我觉得有时候我们低估了水的力量。

sentences.en: I think water just happens to be around and it's like a commodity, really.
sentences.zh: 我觉得水只是恰好存在，它真的就像一种日常用品。

sentences.en: But water is so meaningful.
sentences.zh: 但水非常有意义。

sentences.en: It can really, really teach us.
sentences.zh: 它真的能教会我们很多。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it's natural and it is so accessible.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，它是自然的，而且非常容易获取。

sentences.en: But for me, it's like pure presence.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，它就像纯粹的当下。

sentences.en: You know, like when you're so busy in the daytime, you've always got divided attention.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像白天你太忙的时候，你的注意力总是分散的。

sentences.en: But water, what it does, it demands our 100% attention.
sentences.zh: 但水所做的是，它要求我们百分之百的专注。

sentences.en: And that's the message that I always give to my parents as well, because you do have to be really respectful around water and you always have to supervise.
sentences.zh: 这也是我一直传达给家长们的信息，因为在水边你必须非常尊重它，而且必须时刻监管。

sentences.en: So I have a little tagline that I always share with all my swim families, and I always say it's all about 100% attention, not divided attention.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个小口号，总是分享给我所有的游泳家庭，我总是说，关键在于百分之百的专注，而不是分散的注意力。

sentences.en: And that has a real powerful meaning for presence with the baby.
sentences.zh: 这对与婴儿共处当下的意义非常重大。

sentences.en: But also you're in a medium, if you are in a swimming pool, that is very much skin to skin.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你在游泳池里，你处于一种非常亲密的肌肤接触状态。

sentences.en: Or, of course, if you're in the bath as well, baby's in the bath and they're really enjoying that activity.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你在浴缸里也是一样，宝宝在浴缸里，他们非常享受那个活动。

sentences.en: But it's an activity that you can be with your baby.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你可以和宝宝在一起的活动。

sentences.en: So very much with your baby rather than, you know, doing things to your baby, because there's lots of things out there that you have to do.
sentences.zh: 是真正地“与”宝宝在一起，而不是对宝宝“做”些什么，因为外面有很多你必须对宝宝做的事情。

sentences.en: But this is more of an activity that you can really, really enjoy together, like almost like mutual delight.
sentences.zh: 但这更多是一种你们可以真正共同享受的活动，就像一种相互的愉悦。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And in a world where we're so switched on, where we often might have a phone in our hands, this is an opportunity to be screen free.
sentences.zh: 在这个我们时刻保持在线、手里经常拿着手机的世界里，这是一个远离屏幕的机会。

sentences.en: And I think really, it's reminding me of some of the kind of infant parent observation stuff that we might get in psychology, looking at the quality of that eye gaze,
sentences.zh: 这真的让我想起了一些我们在心理学中可能会接触到的婴儿与父母观察的内容，观察那种眼神交流的质量，

sentences.en: looking at being attuned, really, and following your baby's lead.
sentences.zh: 观察那种协调一致，真正跟随宝宝的引导。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about how you see that unfold with babies and parents?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们讲讲你是如何看待这种互动在婴儿和父母之间展开的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so when we are with babies in water, the nice thing is that a lot of the time we're down at their eye level as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我们和宝宝在水里时，好的一点是很多时候我们也处于他们的视线水平。

sentences.en: And again, you talked about eye contact.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，你提到了眼神交流。

sentences.en: That's really lovely to really just follow their lead.
sentences.zh: 能够真正跟随他们的引导真是太好了。

sentences.en: And sometimes babies, you know, they have to just have that sensory break.
sentences.zh: 有时候宝宝，你知道，他们需要那种感官休息。

sentences.en: They gaze away, but they can come in.
sentences.zh: 他们会移开目光，但他们又会转回来。

sentences.en: But you're in a much closer contact situation with your baby.
sentences.zh: 但你和宝宝处于一种接触更紧密的状态。

sentences.en: And a lot of the time, if you're in a swimming pool or in the bath, you've got beautiful, beautiful skin to skin as well, which is really, really nice.
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候，如果你在游泳池或浴缸里，你们还有非常美妙的肌肤接触，这真的非常非常好。

sentences.en: But what we're doing is we are really feeling into baby's cues.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的是真正去感受宝宝的暗示。

sentences.en: And, you know, do they like their bath?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们喜欢洗澡吗？

sentences.en: How are they feeling today?
sentences.zh: 他们今天感觉如何？

sentences.en: Are they a little bit fussy?
sentences.zh: 他们有点烦躁吗？

sentences.en: Or are they really active and ready for their bath?
sentences.zh: 还是他们非常活跃，准备好洗澡了？

sentences.en: So I think baby is really able to, you know, present how they're feeling as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为宝宝确实能够表达出他们的感受。

sentences.en: And because, as you say, we have like less distractions, we can pick up and we can really attune our cues as well.
sentences.zh: 而且正如你所说，因为干扰更少，我们可以捕捉到这些信号，并真正调整我们的互动。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember, I think I was probably day three or day four when I had my first baby, who you got to know a little bit as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得，大概是我生第一个宝宝后的第三天或第四天，你也稍微了解过他。

sentences.en: And we'll talk about that shortly.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: But it was like the three day sort of weep, really.
sentences.zh: 但那就像是产后第三天的那种情绪崩溃，真的。

sentences.en: You know, I was so overcome.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时太难受了。

sentences.en: I'd had a section.
sentences.zh: 我做了剖腹产。

sentences.en: I was still in loads of pain.
sentences.zh: 我仍然感到非常疼痛。

sentences.en: My milk was all coming in.
sentences.zh: 我的奶水正在下来。

sentences.en: And I was sitting on the toilet, lid closed, as my husband was running a bath for him.
sentences.zh: 我坐在马桶上，盖子盖着，我丈夫正在为他放洗澡水。

sentences.en: And I think it was probably his first bath.
sentences.zh: 我想那可能是他的第一次洗澡。

sentences.en: And I was just holding him, waiting for the, I think I was holding him naked because he was ready to get in the bath, ready for him to get in the water.
sentences.zh: 我只是抱着他，等着，我想我当时赤身裸体地抱着他，因为他准备好进浴缸了，准备好让他下水了。

sentences.en: I was just like crying.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在哭。

sentences.en: And I was just like, I just love him.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，我太爱他了。

sentences.en: I just love him.
sentences.zh: 我太爱他了。

sentences.en: But there's something about those very early days and those very early experiences and trying to get it right.
sentences.zh: 但在那些最初的日子里，在那些最初的经历中，以及试图把事情做好，总有一些特别的东西。

sentences.en: I think he might even have been crying at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想当时他可能甚至在哭。

sentences.en: How do we, how do we begin to support those very early baths, especially if they are crying and they're upset?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何开始支持那些最初的洗澡，尤其是如果他们正在哭闹和难过的时候？

sentences.en: It's, it's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难。

sentences.en: We've got all of these hormones going on.
sentences.zh: 我们体内所有的荷尔蒙都在波动。

sentences.en: We are sleep deprived.
sentences.zh: 我们睡眠不足。

sentences.en: You know, if we're thinking about the very early days, I mean, mine didn't sleep for like 20 months, that first one.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们回想最初的日子，我的第一个孩子有 20 个月没睡过整觉。

sentences.en: But it's just really hard, Jo.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很难，Jo。

sentences.en: How do we try and be mindful?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何尝试保持正念？

sentences.en: How do we try and be respectful of that process?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何尝试尊重那个过程？

sentences.en: It's going to be very different to what they're used to as well.
sentences.zh: 这和他们习惯的也会非常不同。

sentences.en: And I think what we've got to be reminded is that every baby is different.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要记住的是，每个宝宝都是不同的。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of babies that have a natural affinity to water and they find water really soothing and calming.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多宝宝对水有天然的亲近感，他们觉得水非常舒缓和冷静。

sentences.en: So if you have got a fuzzy baby, perhaps water is going to be the absolute perfect place that's going to really, really calm them down.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有一个烦躁的宝宝，也许水会是让他们真正平静下来的绝佳场所。

sentences.en: And it's going to really soothe them, particularly for before bed, you can start a little routine.
sentences.zh: 它真的会安抚他们，特别是在睡前，你可以开始一个小小的仪式。

sentences.en: Of course, there are some babies that they have just that tiny little bit more extra, extra stimulation.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些宝宝确实会多出那么一点点额外的刺激。

sentences.en: And then that can actually just be too much.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，这实际上可能就太多了。

sentences.en: So I think the important message for anybody, really, and parents and caregivers is that bath time doesn't actually have to be the same time of day.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对任何人，包括父母和看护人来说，重要的信息是洗澡时间其实不必每天都在同一时间。

sentences.en: We're really tuning in to when baby is ready.
sentences.zh: 我们真正需要关注的是宝宝什么时候准备好了。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of the time we think about it has to be at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多时候我们认为它必须在一天结束时进行。

sentences.en: But I would say, you know, when is good for you and when is good for baby?
sentences.zh: 但我会说，什么时候对你方便，什么时候对宝宝好？

sentences.en: And it's OK to make a few mistakes because baby is just, you know, always forgiving us for trying.
sentences.zh: 犯一点错也没关系，因为宝宝总是会原谅我们的尝试。

sentences.en: And I think the important thing is, is just being together in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的事情，就是在那一刻在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I have to confess, I don't think I am the funnest of parents, Jo.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，Jo，我不认为我是最有趣的父母。

sentences.en: I think I am.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我是。

sentences.en: I'm cuddly.
sentences.zh: 我很爱拥抱。

sentences.en: I am nurturing.
sentences.zh: 我很会照顾人。

sentences.en: For whatever reason, maybe my own developmental experiences, I don't think I'm super fun.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，也许是我自己的成长经历，我觉得我不是特别有趣。

sentences.en: And so my husband always used to do way more fun baths than I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我丈夫总是比我做更多有趣的洗澡活动。

sentences.en: How can we empower people to make bath time fun and nurturing?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何赋予人们力量，让洗澡时间变得既有趣又充满关怀？

sentences.en: So I always come back to almost like a little bit of a sensory five.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是回到一种类似感官五感的做法。

sentences.en: So you have got your voice and babies love our sing song voices.
sentences.zh: 你有你的声音，宝宝们喜欢我们唱歌般的声音。

sentences.en: So we don't even have to like sing or do rhymes, but they just love when we talk to them,
sentences.zh: 所以我们甚至不需要唱歌或念儿歌，但他们就是喜欢我们跟他们说话，

sentences.en: talking through the bath time as well, adding in simple words, splashing and just making up things.
sentences.zh: 在洗澡时进行交流，加入简单的词汇，泼水，编造一些事情。

sentences.en: Baby loves that movement in the bath.
sentences.zh: 宝宝喜欢在浴缸里的那种动作。

sentences.en: Babies love to wriggle.
sentences.zh: 宝宝喜欢扭动。

sentences.en: And of course, on dry land, they're quite fixed.
sentences.zh: 当然，在陆地上，他们是被固定的。

sentences.en: But in the bath, there is so much more free movement.
sentences.zh: 但在浴缸里，有更多的自由活动空间。

sentences.en: And then we have got that beautiful eye contact as well.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还有那种美妙的眼神交流。

sentences.en: I was saying they really, really love us when we're just watching and looking together and then adding in just a really simple bath toy.
sentences.zh: 我刚才说，当我们一起观察和注视时，他们真的非常喜欢我们，然后再加上一个非常简单的洗澡玩具。

sentences.en: So nothing too much could be just some plastic balls or a simple cup.
sentences.zh: 所以不需要太多，可能只是一些塑料球或一个简单的杯子。

sentences.en: So really, really simple things for babies in the bath, definitely.
sentences.zh: 所以对浴缸里的宝宝来说，真的非常简单，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: One of my favourite things and something I've still got, actually, was from a friend who'd had a baby, I think, around the same time as me.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的东西之一，而且我至今还留着，其实是一位朋友送的，她生孩子的时间大概和我差不多。

sentences.en: And she bought us a set of 10 stacking cups and all of them had like slightly different holes in the bottom.
sentences.zh: 她给我们买了一套 10 个的叠叠杯，底部都有稍微不同的孔。

sentences.en: So they all came out slightly differently.
sentences.zh: 所以它们流出的水稍微有点不同。

sentences.en: And we use those so much.
sentences.zh: 我们用了好多次。

sentences.en: And we actually still use the big blue one in our bathroom to keep all our toothpaste thin because, you know, it's just they've been such a part of our story.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上现在还在浴室里用那个大的蓝色杯子装牙膏，因为你知道，它们已经成为我们故事的一部分了。

sentences.en: It was really hard to let them go.
sentences.zh: 真的很难舍弃它们。

sentences.en: But yeah, like you might just enjoy this.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你可能会喜欢这个。

sentences.en: But I know if people are thinking about baby swimming as a rite of passage, and I would say I loved it.
sentences.zh: 但我知道如果人们把婴儿游泳视为一种成长仪式，我会说我喜欢它。

sentences.en: So I did it with you with my youngest and I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我和我最小的孩子一起参加过，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: It was such a special time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段非常特别的时光。

sentences.en: But I'm guessing you probably get parents that are actually scared of water or or maybe aren't swimmers themselves.
sentences.zh: 但我猜你可能也会遇到那些实际上怕水，或者自己本身就不会游泳的父母。

sentences.en: How do you encourage them to still think that maybe that's something they should do with their baby?
sentences.zh: 你如何鼓励他们仍然认为这可能是他们应该和宝宝一起做的事情？

sentences.en: So I always say start home in the bath.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是说从家里的浴缸开始。

sentences.en: And I think there are just so many things that you can do for water acclimatisation.
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多事情你可以做来适应水环境。

sentences.en: And I think that can, you know, just break barriers, really, of just knowing that your baby is comfortable in the water.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的可以打破障碍，只要知道你的宝宝在水里很舒服就行。

sentences.en: And, you know, go into the lovely splashy moments and things like that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，去享受那些泼水的时刻之类的。

sentences.en: And you think, oh, actually, yeah, you know, let's try it.
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，其实，是的，让我们试试吧。

sentences.en: And I think the environment is really important.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为环境非常重要。

sentences.en: So going to a pool that you perhaps know and it's really familiar or just going and having a walk around before you can get into the pool and talking to the teacher.
sentences.zh: 所以去一个你可能熟悉且非常了解的游泳池，或者在进入游泳池之前先去走走，和教练谈谈。

sentences.en: If you're going to class or just, you know, people around the pool, if it's just an open session.
sentences.zh: 如果你要去上课，或者只是和游泳池周围的人交流，如果这只是一个开放时段的话。

sentences.en: And I would always say check the water temperature as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我总是会说也要检查水温。

sentences.en: Now, I think some pools can be quite cold.
sentences.zh: 现在，我觉得有些游泳池可能相当冷。

sentences.en: So I'd say, you know, pick a nice warm pool, particularly if you are with your baby.
sentences.zh: 所以我建议，选一个温暖舒适的游泳池，特别是如果你和宝宝在一起的话。

sentences.en: And they just know the areas of the pool.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要熟悉游泳池的区域。

sentences.en: So you don't have to.
sentences.zh: 所以你不必强求。

sentences.en: I think we put a lot of pressure on ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们给自己施加了太大的压力。

sentences.en: We have to swim.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得必须得“游泳”。

sentences.en: But no, go in there, just holding baby, being together in the water and even walking around is absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 但不是的，进去，只是抱着宝宝，在水里待在一起，甚至只是走来走去也完全没问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's hard, isn't it, when you've got a baby on a schedule as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，当你还要按时间表照顾宝宝时，这很难，不是吗？

sentences.en: If it's like, you know, your swim lesson time is like usual nap time or lunchtime or when you'd usually feed them.
sentences.zh: 如果你的游泳课时间正好是通常的小睡时间、午餐时间，或者你通常喂奶的时间。

sentences.en: Like I remember thinking, oh, what if he's going to be asleep or, you know, it's really hard to disrupt that.
sentences.zh: 就像我记得当时想，哦，如果他睡着了怎么办，或者，打乱那个节奏真的很难。

sentences.en: But I think we also need to think about actually, yeah, routine is essential.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们也需要考虑，其实，是的，规律是必不可少的。

sentences.en: It's kind of good for our own sanity.
sentences.zh: 这对我们自己的理智有好处。

sentences.en: My babies didn't get that memo.
sentences.zh: 我的宝宝们没收到那个备忘录。

sentences.en: They didn't really do schedules.
sentences.zh: 他们真的不按时间表来。

sentences.en: But it's still important.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然很重要。

sentences.en: And I think for our own mental health as parents, it's still important that we're doing things together.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，作为父母，为了我们自己的心理健康，我们一起做些事情仍然很重要。

sentences.en: Like I really love baby massage.
sentences.zh: 比如我真的很喜欢婴儿按摩。

sentences.en: I really love baby swimming with you.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢和你一起带宝宝游泳。

sentences.en: Because it's that reciprocal thing, but it's something that gets you out of the house as well.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一种互动，而且也能让你走出家门。

sentences.en: Otherwise, your life can become very insular.
sentences.zh: 否则，你的生活会变得非常封闭。

sentences.en: And you, I think, even beginning to think that I can't go out by myself or I can't do this.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你甚至会开始觉得我不能独自出门，或者我做不到这一点。

sentences.en: Or, you know, like it really matters that these activities, they're not just maternity or paternity leave rites of passage.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，这些活动真的很重要，它们不仅仅是产假或陪产假的过渡仪式。

sentences.en: We are creating and developing those very early attachment relationships that we hope will become long term lovely relationships in the future.
sentences.zh: 我们正在创造和发展那些早期的依恋关系，我们希望这些关系在未来能成为长期美好的关系。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's a relationship that we are building with our baby, but also others as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我们与宝宝建立的关系，但也是与其他人建立的关系。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, we mustn't forget babies.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，我们不能忘记宝宝。

sentences.en: Babies, we're all born social little humans and they love being with other babies as well.
sentences.zh: 宝宝，我们生来就是社交小人类，他们也喜欢和其他宝宝在一起。

sentences.en: It's so nice in the pool or if you've got people around the house as well, you know, when they just see and then it's just that surprise, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 在泳池里，或者如果你家里周围也有人，你知道，当他们看到彼此，那种惊喜的感觉真是太好了，不是吗？

sentences.en: But I think in the water, I don't know if you've heard of the blue mind theory, that there's actually a lot of science and research that water has a way,
sentences.zh: 但我认为在水里，我不知道你是否听说过“蓝色心灵”理论，实际上有很多科学研究表明，水有一种方式，

sentences.en: a magic way of actually releasing happy hormones in the brain.
sentences.zh: 一种神奇的方式，可以真正释放大脑中的快乐荷尔蒙。

sentences.en: And people that are in water or around water are actually happier as well.
sentences.zh: 而且在水里或水边的人实际上也更快乐。

sentences.en: So there's lots of research around the blue mind.
sentences.zh: 所以关于“蓝色心灵”有很多研究。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think if we are a little bit low or a bit tired or, yeah, let's see if we can maybe run a bath or go to the pool.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想如果我们心情有点低落或有点累，或者，是的，让我们看看能不能放个澡或者去泳池。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个主意。

sentences.en: And it's making me think about people that live by the sea and regularly get in the water.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了那些住在海边并经常下水的人。

sentences.en: They seem pretty happy, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们看起来很开心，不是吗？

sentences.en: And our bath broke a couple of years ago, Joe, and the whole bathroom has needed fixing and just tearing out and it's something we've never quite got around to.
sentences.zh: 我们的浴缸几年前坏了，乔，整个浴室都需要修理和拆除，我们一直没抽出时间来弄。

sentences.en: But when we were on holiday in the summer, we had a lovely bath and myself and my youngest would be using that bath daily, not together at this age, but daily.
sentences.zh: 但夏天度假时，我们有一个很棒的浴缸，我和我最小的孩子每天都会用那个浴缸，虽然在这个年纪我们不是一起洗，但确实是每天都用。

sentences.en: And it I just thought, oh, I so love a bath.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哦，我太喜欢泡澡了。

sentences.en: I'm probably a more bath person than a shower person.
sentences.zh: 我可能更喜欢泡澡而不是淋浴。

sentences.en: And it's really made me think, yeah, we do need to get this bathroom situation sorted because I need my regular baths.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我觉得，是的，我们确实需要把浴室的情况解决好，因为我需要定期泡澡。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, everybody's different.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，每个人都不一样。

sentences.en: And they did a lot of different research that even listening to water, seeing any types of water.
sentences.zh: 他们做了很多不同的研究，甚至只是听水声、看各种水，都有效果。

sentences.en: So you don't actually have to live near water as well.
sentences.zh: 所以你其实不必非得住在水边。

sentences.en: And I think that's the interesting thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有趣。

sentences.en: So there is almost like a primitive instinct built in with us that, you know, maybe it's because we know how important water is because we have to have it for life.
sentences.zh: 所以我们体内几乎有一种与生俱来的原始本能，你知道，也许是因为我们知道水有多重要，因为我们必须靠它生存。

sentences.en: That we're primed almost to be attracted to water.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎天生就被水吸引。

sentences.en: So, yeah, listening to water and seeing bodies of water.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，听水声和看水域。

sentences.en: So that might be really helpful for anybody that is really supporting people with mental health to think about some sort of bringing water into therapy as well.
sentences.zh: 所以对于任何真正支持心理健康的人来说，考虑在治疗中引入某种水元素可能会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's so important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，这太重要了，不是吗？

sentences.en: And we've got the whole kind of Wim Hof cold water movement and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们还有整个维姆·霍夫（Wim Hof）冷水运动之类的东西。

sentences.en: But actually, it's just really lovely to be in water, to develop your own rituals around water.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，待在水里，围绕水建立自己的仪式，真的非常美好。

sentences.en: And I think, like you said, to be really mindful of thinking about how that water feels on your skin.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，就像你说的，要真正留心去感受水在皮肤上的感觉。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I find that I think very different thoughts.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我发现我的想法会变得非常不同。

sentences.en: It helps me to think more clearly when I'm relaxed and in water.
sentences.zh: 当我放松并待在水里时，它能帮助我更清晰地思考。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: I love that idea, Jo.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个主意，乔。

sentences.en: And, you know, you can develop your own sense, you know, can really up level the sensory, can't you?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你可以培养自己的感官，你知道，真的可以提升感官体验，不是吗？

sentences.en: Think about your favourite bath oil sense or, yeah, like there's, you know, whether you, I always, this is a little spoiler alert,
sentences.zh: 想想你最喜欢的沐浴油香味，或者，是的，就像，你知道，无论你是否，我总是，这是一个小剧透，

sentences.en: every bath I've had probably for the last 10 or 15 years, I have listened to the Ray LaMontagne Trouble album.
sentences.zh: 过去10到15年里我泡的每一次澡，我都在听雷·拉蒙塔涅（Ray LaMontagne）的《Trouble》专辑。

sentences.en: I would declare that to be the perfect bath soundtrack, like every bath.
sentences.zh: 我会宣布那是完美的沐浴配乐，每一次泡澡都是。

sentences.en: So for me, I just love that ritualistic nature of that and just the thoughts that come.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我只是喜欢那种仪式感，以及随之而来的思绪。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢它。

sentences.en: But also we're born from amniotic fluid, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 但我们也是从羊水中出生的，不是吗？

sentences.en: We've been surrounded in water for the whole of our gestation.
sentences.zh: 我们在整个妊娠期都被水包围着。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's something about the power of water.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否与水的力量有关。

sentences.en: I'm sure it is.
sentences.zh: 我相信是的。

sentences.en: And I think also just our nervous systems have an almost like social connection.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们的神经系统也有一种近乎社交的联系。

sentences.en: So if we're building that ritual up and we know that feeling, even if we've had a bad day, again, just the music, the sound of the bath,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们建立了那种仪式，并且我们熟悉那种感觉，即使我们度过了糟糕的一天，再次，只要音乐、洗澡的声音，

sentences.en: something inside, doesn't it, switches over and goes, oh, I know what this is.
sentences.zh: 内心深处的东西，不是吗，就会切换过来，然后说，哦，我知道这是什么。

sentences.en: And it's just like, oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，是的。

sentences.en: So I think there's nothing better at the end of the day to have a bath yourself if you feel like, oh, I really, really need to.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为如果你觉得，哦，我真的非常需要，那么在一天结束时自己泡个澡是再好不过的了。

sentences.en: Or, yeah, if your baby is just needing that time with you as well.
sentences.zh: 或者，是的，如果你的宝宝也需要和你在一起的那段时光。

sentences.en: So I would always suggest have a little think about introducing some water rituals together, definitely.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是建议，一定要考虑一下一起引入一些水的仪式。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And thinking about, I think it's thinking about making that shift with even bath times from, oh, I've got to do this or, you know, this is a thing we must do,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这是关于即使在洗澡时间也要做出转变，从“哦，我必须做这个”或者“这是我们必须做的事情”，

sentences.en: to thinking about it as an activity, something to be enjoyed and look forward to.
sentences.zh: 转变为把它当作一种活动，一种值得享受和期待的事情。

sentences.en: And I really like the idea of maybe thinking about when you do that in the day when they're most receptive to that,
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这种想法，也许可以考虑在一天中他们最容易接受的时候进行，

sentences.en: rather than thinking, oh, God, we've got to do that at the end of every day.
sentences.zh: 而不是想，哦，天哪，我们每天结束时都必须做那个。

sentences.en: Or, you know, when maybe your resources are sapped, maybe the baby's resources are sapped as well.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，当你的精力耗尽时，也许宝宝的精力也耗尽了。

sentences.en: It's, you know, respecting both of you, really.
sentences.zh: 这真的是在尊重你们双方。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think also that we just underestimate the power of water.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们也低估了水的力量。

sentences.en: And there's so many times when, you know, it's there and it's accessible, it's free and it's natural.
sentences.zh: 有很多时候，你知道，它就在那里，触手可及，它是免费的，也是自然的。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes just because it's there, we forget about it, don't we?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有时仅仅因为它就在那里，我们就忘记了它，不是吗？

sentences.en: But, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I think, you know, thinking about water in a different way, in a mindful way, is, yeah, different mind shift for people.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，以一种不同的方式，以一种正念的方式思考水，对人们来说是一种不同的思维转变。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you've made water your whole career, certainly since you became a parent anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且你已经把水作为你的整个职业，至少在你成为父母之后是这样。

sentences.en: And I remember when we were in the pool together and that's probably the end of the lesson and you were like, oh, I've got this dream to have my own pool one day.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们在泳池里的时候，那可能快下课了，你说，哦，我有一个梦想，有一天能拥有自己的泳池。

sentences.en: And then at the end of our sessions, I think you then opened your first pool.
sentences.zh: 然后在那次课程结束时，我想你就开了你的第一个泳池。

sentences.en: I think you've now got a couple of pools.
sentences.zh: 我想你现在已经有几个泳池了。

sentences.en: And it really is, it's become your life's mission, hasn't it?
sentences.zh: 这确实已经成为了你的人生使命，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I was really fortunate that as a child, I always used to spend a lot of time in water with my dad.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，我很幸运，小时候我总是和爸爸一起花很多时间在水里。

sentences.en: And I think that that built that almost foundation relationship.
sentences.zh: 我认为这建立了那种近乎基础的关系。

sentences.en: And then when I was made redundant on maternity leave, you know, when you just like search and you're thinking, oh, I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 然后当我在产假期间被裁员时，你知道，当你只是在寻找，你在想，哦，我不知道该做什么。

sentences.en: I just happened to land and I was taking my little boy baby swim and this is going back 22 years now.
sentences.zh: 我只是碰巧遇到了，当时我正带着我的小男孩去婴儿游泳，这已经是22年前的事了。

sentences.en: And I was, I was a little bit low at the time because I didn't have a lot of friends.
sentences.zh: 当时我有点低落，因为我没有很多朋友。

sentences.en: I moved areas.
sentences.zh: 我搬了家。

sentences.en: So it was almost that, as we've been talking about, that postnatal support group as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎就像我们一直在谈论的那样，也是一个产后支持小组。

sentences.en: So I really lent into my friends group through swimming.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实通过游泳依靠了我的朋友圈。

sentences.en: So it definitely had much more of that emotional attachment when I got made redundant with my daughter.
sentences.zh: 所以当我带着女儿被裁员时，它绝对有了更多那种情感依恋。

sentences.en: It was almost like they're just presenting.
sentences.zh: 就像是它们自然而然地出现了。

sentences.en: I was like, right, fine.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，好吧，没问题。

sentences.en: So it's almost like a path.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎就像一条路。

sentences.en: And when I was hiring pools, I just felt that, yeah, we could be doing this a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 当我租用泳池时，我只是觉得，是的，我们可以做得有点不同。

sentences.en: The environment needs to be different for babies, warmer, lots of different new facilities.
sentences.zh: 环境对宝宝来说需要不同，更温暖，有很多不同的新设施。

sentences.en: And I wanted to create much more of a community connection.
sentences.zh: 我想创造更多社区联系。

sentences.en: So it was really tough building our own pools.
sentences.zh: 所以建立我们自己的泳池真的很艰难。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I absolutely love our swim families and the community that we're building.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我绝对热爱我们的游泳家庭和我们正在建立的社区。

sentences.en: And then through just introducing now out to others and more of like saying that the bath can be that first step to the pool and really helping and supporting others with that as well.
sentences.zh: 然后通过现在向其他人介绍，更多地说是把洗澡作为去泳池的第一步，并真正帮助和支持其他人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What I liked about your approach, Jo, it was it was so respectful of the baby.
sentences.zh: 乔，我喜欢你的方法的一点是，它对宝宝非常尊重。

sentences.en: We're not doing like not chucking them in.
sentences.zh: 我们不是那种直接把他们扔进去。

sentences.en: We're not dunking them straight away.
sentences.zh: 我们不会立刻把他们浸入水中。

sentences.en: Like we're not putting those funny little floaty things on their heads and letting them float off by themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们不会给他们头上戴那些奇怪的小浮具，然后让他们自己漂走。

sentences.en: Like it was really empowering to to respect the baby and to gently introduce a few splashes to their face of the water so that they could see that for themselves.
sentences.zh: 这真的很能赋予人力量，去尊重宝宝，并温柔地在他们脸上洒一点水，这样他们就能自己看到这一点。

sentences.en: And just to be baby led, you know, I think sometimes we did gently pull baby underwater, but only when they were when we thought that that would be OK.
sentences.zh: 而且只是以宝宝为主导，你知道，我想有时我们确实会温柔地把宝宝拉到水下，但只有在我们认为那样没问题的时候。

sentences.en: And I hope I'm not remiss remembering that, Jo.
sentences.zh: 我希望我没有记错，乔。

sentences.en: I think that does happen at some points in the lessons.
sentences.zh: 我想在课程的某些时候确实会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: But it's empowering you to think about what's right for your baby, what's right for what's right for you and them on any given day.
sentences.zh: 但这赋予了你思考什么对你的宝宝是正确的，什么对你和他们在任何特定日子是正确的能力。

sentences.en: Like I just I really loved, really loved your way.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢，真的很喜欢你的方式。

sentences.en: And I found it really empowering, actually, as a as a first time mum, just to think about how to do these things and to give me confidence.
sentences.zh: 作为一个新手妈妈，我发现这真的很能赋予我力量，去思考如何做这些事情，并给我信心。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think what's interesting over the 15 years or particularly when when you were swimming as well, things have changed and we've become much more attuned.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为有趣的是，在过去的15年里，或者特别是在你游泳的时候，事情已经改变了，我们变得更加协调了。

sentences.en: So, as you said, you know, when we were teaching babies then, we're always very respectful.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如你所说，你知道，那时我们教宝宝时，我们总是非常尊重他们。

sentences.en: We gave them the cue.
sentences.zh: 我们给了他们提示。

sentences.en: We thought they were ready.
sentences.zh: 我们认为他们准备好了。

sentences.en: We look for those cues, those bright eyes leaning forward and we allow them into the water.
sentences.zh: 我们寻找那些信号，那些明亮的眼睛，身体前倾，然后我们允许他们进入水中。

sentences.en: Now, we're really, really tuned in to sort of taking again, much more of a little bit more of a sort of just step back.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们真的非常非常专注于采取一种更加退后一步的态度。

sentences.en: And rather than holding baby, we're really now allowing their very first underwater dip themselves.
sentences.zh: 与其抱着宝宝，我们现在真的允许他们进行第一次水下潜水。

sentences.en: So baby swimming is really, really changing in the UK, not so much around the world.
sentences.zh: 所以婴儿游泳在英国真的在发生很大变化，在世界其他地方则没那么多。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, one of these things might sort of catch up.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道，这些事情中的一件可能会赶上来。

sentences.en: But, yeah, we do have a lot of different practices worldwide and I'm a massive advocate of child led baby swimming because, well, at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我们在世界各地确实有很多不同的做法，我是以儿童为主导的婴儿游泳的坚定倡导者，因为，嗯，归根结底，

sentences.en: you want your children to be happier and safer and to, for me, be connected to the water rather than, you know, just building in in built fears, really.
sentences.zh: 你希望你的孩子更快乐、更安全，对我来说，是与水建立联系，而不是，你知道，只是建立内在的恐惧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think one of the limiting factors can be the cost of baby swimming because you're having smaller groups.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为限制因素之一可能是婴儿游泳的成本，因为你的小组规模较小。

sentences.en: And, of course, the very high overheads of running a pool or hiring a pool, it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 当然，经营泳池或租用泳池的高额管理费用，这并不容易。

sentences.en: It's easy to kind of think about the companies as being, you know, mercenary, like how can they dare charge us that much?
sentences.zh: 很容易认为这些公司是唯利是图的，就像他们怎么敢收我们那么多钱？

sentences.en: But the overheads are really high and it's not the same as having a whole big leisure centre full of paying customers.
sentences.zh: 但管理费用确实很高，这和拥有一个充满付费客户的大型休闲中心是不一样的。

sentences.en: And so it is going to be perhaps more expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能会更贵一些。

sentences.en: I think, you know, you guys are the most expensive baby class I did, but I would say it was it was worth it.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，你们是我参加过的最贵的婴儿课程，但我会说这是值得的。

sentences.en: And what I learned from that and what what I took from that with my son, I think it was really, really important.
sentences.zh: 我从中学到的东西，以及我带着儿子从中获得的东西，我认为这真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: I think it just works on all different levels, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我认为它在各个层面都有效，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's a class for us.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的课程。

sentences.en: It's a class for baby.
sentences.zh: 这是宝宝的课程。

sentences.en: But I think also just long term, you know, we know that we're giving them the best start developmentally as well.
sentences.zh: 但我认为从长远来看，你知道，我们知道我们在发育方面给了他们最好的开始。

sentences.en: You know, swimming has one of those magical ways of like just crossing all the brain domains, you know, the cognitive, the social, the speech and language.
sentences.zh: 你知道，游泳有一种神奇的方式，可以跨越所有大脑领域，你知道，认知、社交、语言和言语。

sentences.en: It's just it's all there.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里。

sentences.en: So I would say if parents were looking for any class, you know, baby swimming, pop it up there.
sentences.zh: 所以我建议，如果父母在寻找任何课程，你知道，婴儿游泳，把它排在前面。

sentences.en: Or if you can't go to classes, then definitely, definitely go yourself.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你不能去上课，那么绝对，绝对要自己去。

sentences.en: There shouldn't really be any barrier to, you know, go into water or having water at home, really start there.
sentences.zh: 去水边或在家里用水真的不应该有任何障碍，真的从那里开始。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you've got new classes as well, like bath time classes.
sentences.zh: 而且你也有新的课程，比如洗澡时间课程。

sentences.en: Could you tell us about those?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们关于那些课程的事吗？

sentences.en: Yes, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Well, just love really celebrating the fourth trimester and just slowing it all down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是真的很喜欢庆祝第四孕期，并把一切都慢下来。

sentences.en: And I do think that sometimes, you know, rushing to the pool isn't always baby led.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为有时，你知道，冲向泳池并不总是以宝宝为主导的。

sentences.en: I've been talking about like the first maybe sort of like two months and the bath can be the perfect place.
sentences.zh: 我一直在谈论前两个月左右，洗澡可以是一个完美的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, sometimes just being in that social environment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有时只是待在那个社交环境中。

sentences.en: So if you can think of a little bit of like a nurturing touch baby massage mixed with baby swim, that's what we've created.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能想到一点点像滋养触感的婴儿按摩混合婴儿游泳，那就是我们创造的东西。

sentences.en: It's really unique.
sentences.zh: 它真的很独特。

sentences.en: It's called Bath Babies.
sentences.zh: 它叫“洗澡宝宝”（Bath Babies）。

sentences.en: And it's a time where we're really celebrating together, really making sure babies are seen and heard, giving parents really nice bath time tips.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们真正一起庆祝的时刻，真正确保宝宝被看到和听到，给父母提供非常好的洗澡时间小贴士。

sentences.en: And it's really, really good fun as well.
sentences.zh: 而且它也非常非常有意思。

sentences.en: But for me, it's just making early water experiences special, but also it is making things much more accessible.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这不仅是让早期的戏水体验变得特别，更是让它变得更加触手可及。

sentences.en: Because I must admit, when I or before I started Bath Babies, I didn't have an appreciation of how many people perhaps were a bit fearful of going into water themselves
sentences.zh: 因为我必须承认，在创办“沐浴宝贝”（Bath Babies）之前，我并没有意识到有多少人可能对下水本身感到有些恐惧，

sentences.en: or cultural differences or skin or healing from birth, anything really.
sentences.zh: 或者是因为文化差异、皮肤问题，又或是产后康复等各种原因。

sentences.en: I didn't have a huge appreciation.
sentences.zh: 我之前并没有深刻的体会。

sentences.en: So Bath Babies is actually almost like bridging a gap as well, making early water really accessible.
sentences.zh: 所以“沐浴宝贝”实际上也起到了弥合差距的作用，让早期的戏水变得非常容易实现。

sentences.en: So I'm really super excited to bring that to my local community, but also to others as well, supporting others, setting up their own Bath Babies.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常兴奋能把它带给我的社区，同时也支持其他人建立他们自己的“沐浴宝贝”项目。

sentences.en: Yeah, and before we hit record, we were talking about actually, this is a really nice opportunity potentially for people who want to build more experience
sentences.zh: 是的，在录制之前我们就在讨论，对于那些想要积累更多经验的人来说，这确实是一个非常好的机会，

sentences.en: with clinically relevant populations to perhaps take this into their own hands
sentences.zh: 特别是针对临床相关人群，他们或许可以亲自尝试一下，

sentences.en: and think actually, maybe I could set up a little, you know, practice of teaching these Bath classes to people
sentences.zh: 心想：也许我可以建立一个小型的实践项目，教人们进行这些沐浴课程，

sentences.en: so that I could work with postnatal populations and kind of parent and baby dyads.
sentences.zh: 这样我就能与产后人群以及亲子组合一起工作了。

sentences.en: I think it's potentially something that I would have been really, really interested in earlier in my career, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我想如果是在我职业生涯的早期，我肯定会对此非常非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a bit about how those kind of training, training the trainers courses would work, Jo?
sentences.zh: Jo，你能跟我们讲讲这种培训师的培训课程是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So I'm an aquatic tutor and the course has been accredited by SimSpa, which is, like I say, is like the Ofsted of Aquatics in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我是一名水上运动导师，该课程已获得 SimSpa 的认证，正如我所说，它就像是英国水上运动界的 Ofsted（教育标准局）。

sentences.en: All the swim qualifications are accredited and off SimSpa have accredited by babies.
sentences.zh: 所有的游泳资格认证都经过了 SimSpa 的认可，他们也认证了“沐浴宝贝”。

sentences.en: So that's really important, first of all, that people are getting approved and quality training.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，人们能获得认可且高质量的培训，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: And secondly, I like to work with people in all sorts of different ways, whether it's online, face to face.
sentences.zh: 其次，我喜欢以各种不同的方式与人合作，无论是线上还是面对面。

sentences.en: But the idea is that at the end, when they're setting up their case studies, they can actually run and be really confident to run their own classes.
sentences.zh: 但核心理念是，在课程结束时，当他们建立自己的案例研究时，他们能够真正有信心去开展自己的课程。

sentences.en: So we are really appealing to anybody that is working with children 0 to 5 and they want to set up classes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常欢迎任何从事 0 到 5 岁儿童工作并希望开设课程的人。

sentences.en: And it can be like, you know, supportive classes.
sentences.zh: 这可以是某种支持性的课程。

sentences.en: It could be parents that have had really sensitive or babies that have had sensitive beginnings as well.
sentences.zh: 也可以是针对那些经历过敏感时期，或者宝宝有过敏感开端的父母。

sentences.en: You can go down a little more of a sort of a therapeutic way if that is your, you know, your foundation base.
sentences.zh: 如果这是你的基础，你甚至可以走一条更偏向治疗的路线。

sentences.en: But essentially what we're doing is we're creating safe spaces.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，我们是在创造安全的空间。

sentences.en: We're celebrating that fourth trimester and being together.
sentences.zh: 我们在庆祝“第四孕期”，享受在一起的时光。

sentences.en: And then the water's there sort of like holding that space as well.
sentences.zh: 而水就在那里，像是在守护着这个空间。

sentences.en: And I like to say that water is, can be our teacher as well.
sentences.zh: 我常说，水也可以是我们的老师。

sentences.en: You know, go in with the flow.
sentences.zh: 你知道，顺其自然就好。

sentences.en: There are so many different messages that the water can actually teach us and hold in those classes together, really.
sentences.zh: 水确实能教给我们许多不同的信息，并在这些课程中将我们凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think if I was working in a postnatal service where I was doing in-person work,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想如果我是在产后服务机构做面对面的工作，

sentences.en: I would absolutely be saying, I think at least one of us needs to be trained to be able to do this lovely level of intervention
sentences.zh: 我绝对会说，我们中至少得有一个人接受过培训，能够进行这种美妙的干预，

sentences.en: with parents to support that bonding.
sentences.zh: 以支持父母与孩子之间的亲子联结。

sentences.en: So that's another, another avenue.
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一个途径。

sentences.en: Where can people learn more about you and your work, Jo?
sentences.zh: Jo，人们可以在哪里了解更多关于你和你的工作？

sentences.en: And if people did want in-person baby swimming, where are your pools?
sentences.zh: 如果人们想参加线下的婴儿游泳课程，你的泳池在哪里？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So I'm based in Warwickshire.
sentences.zh: 我的基地在沃里克郡（Warwickshire）。

sentences.en: I've got two pools, one in rugby, one in Leamington Spa.
sentences.zh: 我有两个泳池，一个在拉格比（Rugby），一个在皇家利明顿温泉镇（Leamington Spa）。

sentences.en: But I do an awful lot of work online as well.
sentences.zh: 但我也有很多工作是在线上完成的。

sentences.en: So through Aquasensory and the programme is called Bath Babies.
sentences.zh: 通过 Aquasensory，这个项目叫作“沐浴宝贝”。

sentences.en: And I have a book on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 我在亚马逊上还有一本书。

sentences.en: And what I did is I set it at the lowest price.
sentences.zh: 我把它定在了最低价。

sentences.en: So it's really accessible for parents.
sentences.zh: 这样对父母来说非常实惠。

sentences.en: So it's £2.99 Kindle, £3.99 print.
sentences.zh: Kindle 版只要 2.99 英镑，纸质版 3.99 英镑。

sentences.en: And it's called Bath Babies, Creating Beautiful Bonds in Water.
sentences.zh: 书名是《沐浴宝贝：在水中创造美好的联结》。

sentences.en: And it pretty much sums up what we've been talking today, that mindful way and gives us some practices as well.
sentences.zh: 它几乎总结了我们今天讨论的内容，那种正念的方式，并提供了一些练习方法。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: And thank you so much for everything that you do for these developing bonds and relationships with babies and their caregivers.
sentences.zh: 也非常感谢你为促进婴儿与照护者之间这些正在发展的联结和关系所做的一切。

sentences.en: It's really important.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to my guest, Jo, today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢今天的嘉宾 Jo。

sentences.en: I still do think back very fondly on my time with her in the pool with my eldest child.
sentences.zh: 回想起我和她一起在泳池里陪伴我大孩子的时光，我依然感到非常温馨。

sentences.en: How has this episode been for you?
sentences.zh: 这一集对你来说感觉如何？

sentences.en: I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道。

sentences.en: Please do drop a comment if watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，请务必留下评论。

sentences.en: Please do like and subscribe wherever you're watching the show.
sentences.zh: 无论你在哪里收看节目，请一定要点赞并订阅。

sentences.en: And let me know what content you would find helpful in future too.
sentences.zh: 也请告诉我未来你觉得哪些内容会有所帮助。

sentences.en: If you are working with new parents or you are a new parent yourself or want to support or, you know, reach out to someone who is,
sentences.zh: 如果你正在与新手父母一起工作，或者你自己就是一位新手父母，又或者你想支持或联系那些需要帮助的人，

sentences.en: I also really recommend a book by one of my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我还强烈推荐我的一位同事写的一本书。

sentences.en: It's called Mindful New Mum and it's by Dr. Caroline Boyd.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《正念新手妈妈》（Mindful New Mum），作者是 Caroline Boyd 博士。

sentences.en: It really is a lovely, lovely, nourishing read, I would say, for thinking about how to support mothers or how to support yourself in the postnatal period.
sentences.zh: 我想说，这是一本非常美妙、非常有滋养价值的读物，适合思考如何在产后期间支持母亲或支持你自己。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that gets my seal of approval as well as baby swimming.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，除了婴儿游泳，这本书也得到了我的认可。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the aspiring psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将走上成为 Marianne Trent 博士的“有抱负的心理学家播客”之路。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”（One-to-Many）项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员制和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
